text:
Elena Park: @here quick heads-up — we're publishing a new docs policy today: all published code samples must include an explicit license header and an opt-in telemetry flag. Full rollout plan below :mega:

Samir Rao: Clarify: SPDX identifier required in frontmatter?

Elena Park: Yes. Please add SPDX or canonical name in YAML frontmatter. Minimal required keys: license, spdx, telemetry. Example frontmatter to prepend to snippets:

```yaml
---
license: Apache-2.0
spdx: Apache-2.0
telemetry: opt_in  # values: opt_in | opt_out | none
---
```

Joel Kim: Does this affect the SDK example repos (js-sdk, py-sdk)? Automation?

Elena Park: It does. We'll run an automated migration for the top 50 most-viewed pages and open PRs in the docs repo. SDK source examples flagged by the script will get a draft PR in their repos with the suggested frontmatter. Manual review required before merge.

docs-bot: automated scan scheduled: 2026-04-05T09:00Z. Will open up to 50 draft PRs for review.

Maya Singh: Legal has reviewed the policy language and approved the license guidance. See internal policy: https://redwood.internal/legal/docs-code-sample-policy

Legal Bot: Approval recorded: LGTM by legal@redwood (case 2026-0423-CSP). Note: no change to SDK runtime licensing — this is docs-only.

Alex Chen: Will the playground or snippets ingestion break if we add frontmatter?

Elena Park: No — the snippet ingestion pipeline ignores leading YAML frontmatter when executing examples. We verified with the playground team. The only change is the telemetry default for docs examples: we switch to opt_in for sample telemetry calls (so sample calls in docs will not ping telemetry unless user enables it). Production SDK defaults unchanged.

Tina Ortiz: How should we mark archival examples that are copy-left or internal?

Elena Park: If a snippet must remain internal or carries a different license, add `license: private` and mention reason in a short comment. We'll treat `private` as non-publishable in cross-org mirrors.

Samir Rao: Flagging maintainers — please watch for the migration PRs and ping me if you need help with the frontmatter.

Elena Park: Timeline: policy published today, automated PRs Wed (2026-04-05), review window 2 weeks, final sweep + merge by 2026-04-25. If you manage docs or SDK examples, please triage PRs or opt out via the opt-out label in your repo.

Joel Kim: Thanks — appreciate the clear steps.

Maya Singh: I'll coordinate a short docs-writing walkthrough next Tue to show how to add the frontmatter and update snippets.

Elena Park: Thanks team — ping me or @Samir for questions. Will add a checklist in the policy doc and a sample linter rule to CI soon. :thumbsup:
